summary: Float Accounting & Advisory is a Preston VIC firm (offices in Melbourne, Williamstown and Frankston) offering tax, bookkeeping, payroll, advisory and automation, with an e-commerce focus. Adam Abela is Co-Founder and CEO (listed as Head of Advisory on the site), with a long operations background, and has published on process documentation and cloud accounting.

hooks.text: Adam talks publicly about systemising and documenting processes: reconciliation is the obvious repeatable process.
E-commerce focus with Xero app stack implies high-volume payout and platform reconciliation.
Small team across four locations means hours saved go straight to advisory capacity.

risks.text: Adam is an operations leader, not a CPA; the principal accountant (Adrian Monarca) may own tooling decisions.
Team looks very small (LinkedIn shows 3), so budget may be limited.

gaps: Float website pages could not be fetched directly (HTTP 500); relied on search excerpts. No careers/hiring page, podcast, or recent posts found.
